problem_type: Whole-graph and whole-node canvas writes overwrite the paid fact layer (results, versions, run state, result media size) because every write door had to remember the rule on its own
symptom: Agent "undo this batch" / reopen recovery of an interrupted proposal put the pre-proposal canvas back wholesale and removed results that had landed afterwards on nodes the proposal never touched (V-1072); a node put back by an Agent restore-graph or a storyboard row-deletion undo came back spinning without the outcome that arrived while it was gone; restore-node-fields put old meta back over the media size of a later result and was refused outright when any result landed on that node.
direct_cause: proposalUndo applied restore-snapshot through applyExternalGraph, which only kept run state live (result / history / contentJson came from the snapshot); restoreGraph upserted the captured node without consulting outcomes held while it was absent (those lived only in the undo journal, read only by Ctrl+Z); restore-node-fields went through updateNode with the old meta.
class_root: A node mixes an edit layer and a fact layer, and there was no single write boundary owning "facts come from the live store": #1065 (undo replay), #1072 (external write) and #1073 (held outcomes in the undo journal) each patched one door, and the store's action table only said whether an action was a document write, not which layer it writes.
affected_population: Every whole-graph / whole-node canvas write: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, external MCP canvas.apply, Agent proposal compensation (restore-snapshot, restore-graph, restore-node-fields), storyboard row-deletion undo, project load and event-tail replay
Every paid outcome delivered to the open project (generation result, text finalisation, run start / end status), including outcomes that arrive while their node is deleted
entry_points: Store undo / redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, toolbar, director hotkeys, version cards)
External MCP canvas.apply (renderer gateway) and disk gateway apply (main process)
Agent proposal compensation: runProposalUndo, runProposalUndoByChangeId, recoverPendingProposalReceipt, applyProposalBatch abort
Project load (restoreSnapshot) and crash-recovery event tail (applyEventTail)
deliverRunOutcome into the open project when the node is absent (holdRunOutcome)

external_sources.purpose: trackedOrigins undoes only chosen origins, but undoing an insertion removes the inserted item with everything put into it later; Nomi's rule B (undoing node creation keeps a node holding paid results) cannot be expressed, so the store is not replaced by Yjs
Inverse patches are the evaluated next step for the undo stack (registered under-review in self-written.json); not adopted in this change

invariants: Every whole-graph or whole-node write of the canvas store is implemented only in store/canvasDocumentCommit.ts and resolves the fact layer through one rule: edits come from the write, facts (run state, landed result fields, result media size meta keys) come from the live store; the same withLiveNodeFacts is used for disk external writes.

Undo / redo is the only door that may roll back landed fields (the user's own version edits): the target projection plus every later landing re-laid in order, run state from the live store, and a node created by the undone step is kept when it carries a paid landing.

An outcome that arrives while its node is absent is held in the store by nodeId and laid on the node by whichever door brings it back; the application is journaled as a landing so later undo / redo re-lays it.

Every store action declares its layer (session / edit / fact:landing / fact:run / document); the document layer equals the commit-port slice and the fact layer equals the run slice, checked by the compiler.
A proposal's before-image is never applied as a whole graph; it is expanded into per-object compensation (delete-nodes, disconnect-edges, restore-graph, restore-node-fields).

door_reduction.why_not: Call-site doors do not shrink: each caller is a distinct entry that must exist (Agent compensation, storyboard row undo, MCP canvas.apply, disk gateway, run delivery). What shrinks is where the fact rule lives: before, three owners each implemented part of it (reapplyLandedOutcomes for undo / redo / applyExternalGraph run state, mergeExternalCanvasWrite's protected-field set, the undo journal's outcome-held reading), and whole graphs were assigned in two store files plus updateNode for restore-node-fields; after, every whole write ends in the one commit switch of canvasDocumentCommit.ts and every fact decision in settleNodeFacts / withLiveNodeFacts (the disk gateway merge calls the same withLiveNodeFacts). mergeExternalCanvasWrite appears twice because renderer and disk share it by design.

generality_proof: The compiler forces every store action into a layer, and the document layer can only be implemented by createCanvasDocumentActions, whose single commit switch exhausts every CanvasDocumentWrite kind and routes every node it keeps or brings back through settleNodeFacts. A new whole writer therefore either goes through that switch or fails to compile; a node coming back through any door picks up held outcomes because the lookup is in settleNodeFacts, not in a door.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: The only implementation of document-layer store actions; one exhaustive commit over CanvasDocumentWrite kinds.
Facts from the live store for surviving nodes; held outcomes laid on returning nodes.
The single declaration of fact fields and the edit-from-write / facts-from-live rule, shared with the disk external write.
Every store action declares its layer; document / fact slices pinned by type assertions.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Expanded by beforeImageCompensation into per-object ops; wholeWriteKeepsFacts.test.ts prediction ② cases red on main, green after.
restoreGraph is a document action; the storyboard case in wholeWriteKeepsFacts.test.ts red on main, green after.
applyExternalGraph({ base, next }) merges inside the commit port; externalCanvasWriteKeepsLanded.test.ts stays green and goes red when withLiveNodeFacts takes the write's facts.
mergeExternalCanvasWrite now applies withLiveNodeFacts; externalCanvasWrite.test.ts goes 8 red under the mutation.

Patches a single node with nodeRunOutcomePatch, not a whole write; its cross-process interleave with the disk gateway is a separate gap pinned by diskWriteInterleave.test.ts (it.fails) and listed in residual_risks.

recurrence.reason: Fourth door of the same class in one day (#1065, #1072, #1073, V-1072); 52 fix commits in 30 days on the 13 landing-chain files.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs applyExternalGraph restoreGraph restoreSnapshot undo redo applyEventTail (18 write doors before; whole writes now only in canvasDocumentCommit.ts)

prevention.invariant: Every store action has a declared layer; document-layer actions are exactly the commit-port slice; fact-layer actions are exactly the run slice.
prevention.failure_mode: tsc fails (verified: classifying restoreGraph or holdRunOutcome as edit gives two TS2322 errors).
prevention.strategy: Make the fact rule a single function behind a single commit switch, and make the compiler refuse any whole writer outside it.

legacy_paths.rationale: reapplyLandedOutcomes removed; outcome-held journal events removed; applyExternalGraph's run-state-only special case and the store-root undo / redo / load bodies moved into the commit port; restoreGraph moved out of the graph slice; restore-snapshot no longer calls a whole-graph action.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party runtime decides the invariant; Immer / zustand are used as before.

migration: No data migration: project file and proposal receipt formats are unchanged. Held outcomes are session state (not persisted), cleared on project load / release, as the journal-held ones were before.
residual_risks: Production batch undo / redo still infers detach from store diffs and redo never re-attaches (prediction ①, pinned it.fails in src/workbench/production/redoReattachesProductionShots.test.ts) — fixed by the planned 删 ② PR.

Renderer disk delivery and main-process disk gateway read-modify-write the same project file without a shared lock or revision check; an external edit can be overwritten (prediction ③, pinned it.fails in src/workbench/generationCanvas/runner/diskWriteInterleave.test.ts).

Agent undo by change id still refuses when any later runtime event touched the proposal's objects (kept conservative; delete-nodes on a node that later got a paid result would otherwise remove it — a product decision).
Held outcomes are not persisted: an app restart between deletion and put-back loses them (same as before).
Real App undo / Agent undo with a real paid result: unverified (no spend in this line).
